title: Add a FastAPI route and its Next.js proxy handler
description: A new REST endpoint lands as a route module under api/routes/v1/ plus the mandatory proxy route handler under frontend/src/app/api/. Neither file exists yet; the paths are what the change would create. An API change is incomplete until the proxy handler exists too.
notes: expected.proxy_routes is empty because the new handler is part of the change itself, not something impact should discover from the interfaces manifest - a route that does not exist yet has no extracted proxy mapping. The measure here is that both stacks' components and validators are selected from the two seed paths.
